_note: Viewer-facing copy for match-reader. <team> is replaced by the team name from the match file; {fact} placeholders are kept and later filled by the web app from `facts`. DE and VI are DRAFTS until the owner checks them (AGENTS.md). Do not add digits to any text: numbers come only from {facts}. question.text and reveal.plain may be a list of variants; the reader uses the next unused variant each time, so a line is never repeated within a match (AGENTS.md rule 8).

plain.en: Offside. The attacker was ahead of the last defender when the pass was played. The goal is ruled out.
plain.de: Abseits. Der Angreifer stand beim Pass vor dem letzten Verteidiger. Das Tor zählt nicht.
plain.vi: Việt vị. Lúc đường chuyền được thực hiện, cầu thủ tấn công đứng trước hậu vệ cuối cùng. Bàn thắng bị hủy.

plain.en: Offside! The attacker was in front of the last defender at the moment of the pass, so no goal.
plain.de: Abseits! Der Angreifer stand beim Pass vor dem letzten Verteidiger, also kein Tor.
plain.vi: Việt vị! Lúc chuyền bóng, cầu thủ tấn công đứng trước hậu vệ cuối cùng, nên không có bàn thắng.

expert.vi: Việt vị {var_margin_cm} cm, xét theo khung hình lúc chuyền bóng.

plain.en: Offside check. The attacker was level with or behind the last defender, so the goal stands.
plain.de: Abseits-Check. Der Angreifer stand auf gleicher Höhe mit dem letzten Verteidiger oder dahinter, das Tor zählt.
plain.vi: Kiểm tra việt vị. Cầu thủ tấn công đứng ngang hoặc sau hậu vệ cuối cùng, nên bàn thắng được công nhận.

plain.en: Onside! The attacker was not ahead of the last defender, so the goal counts.
plain.de: Kein Abseits! Der Angreifer war nicht vor dem letzten Verteidiger, das Tor zählt.
plain.vi: Không việt vị! Cầu thủ tấn công không đứng trước hậu vệ cuối cùng, nên bàn thắng được công nhận.

plain.en: A foul! Something in the build-up was not allowed, so the goal is cancelled.
